name: sticky-stack
title: 粘性卡片堆叠 Sticky Stack
description: 让卡片依次钉住、缩放，并被后续内容覆盖。

props.name: children
props.description: StickyStackItem elements rendered in stacking order.

props.name: top
props.description: Top offset of the first sticky item in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Visible vertical offset between stacked items in pixels.

props.name: scaleStep
props.description: Scale removed for every card placed above an item.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

usage: `StickyStack` 负责计算整组滚动进度，并自动为直接子级 `StickyStackItem` 注入堆叠顺序。卡片使用原生 `position: sticky` 固定，较早出现的卡片会随整组进度轻微缩小，后续卡片按更高层级覆盖上来。
